label: Aquinas, I q.14 a.2 co. and ad 3: Actual understanding through an intelligible species
locator: I q.14 a.2 co. and ad 3
interpretation: In the third reply the intelligible species actualizes the possible intellect and is that by which the object is understood. Once the intellect understands an object, it can know its own act of understanding and thereby its intellectual power.
attribution: The passage states that our possible intellect is in potency to intelligibles and actually understands its object only insofar as an intelligible species actualizes it, which is the premise.
